name: Kamishiro Mei
source:
Mei is a third-grade student, [url=/c54672]Youko's[/url] closest friend and classmate. She also acts as vice-president of the student council, a role she firmly and strictly fulfills, not because she is a cold girl but because Youko is losing her concentration very quickly.

However, she understands that her friend wants to have a normal high school life without the responsibilities of her role as president, and she relies heavily on [url=/c58417]Masaharu[/url] to entertain her.
